name: LightningNeRF
definition: A neural radiance field method that uses separate density and color encodings (via tcnn), background inverse warping, and color decomposition. It utilizes an occupancy grid for sparse sampling and pretraining density grids from point clouds.
summary: LightningNeRF is an efficient hybrid scene representation for autonomous driving that uses explicit voxel grids for density and implicit hash grids for color to achieve significantly faster training and rendering speeds.
